project.name: ternary-rom 8x8 MAC tile
project.description: Mask-locked ternary inference proof-of-concept. 8x8 matrix-vector multiply with weights in ROM cells. No multipliers, no SRAM for weights.
project.author: ternary-rom contributors

documentation.how_it_works: Weights {-1,0,+1} are encoded in mask-programmed ROM cells. Each clock cycle processes one input element. The accumulator adds (weight=+1), subtracts (weight=-1), or skips (weight=0). After 8 cycles, the output holds the dot product result for the selected column.
documentation.how_to_test: Apply a known input vector, select a column (0-7), assert start, wait for 8 cycles, read the output. Compare against expected dot product computed in software.
documentation.external_hw: None required. Self-contained test in testbench.
